# Comrade Sovia

> Official entry points for the independent music and visual art project and its fictional universe.

Canon version: 1.0.3; updated: 2026-10-15.

## Identity

- Project: [Comrade Sovia](https://sovia.work/en-US/about) — @id https://sovia.work/#project
- Real creator: [Mikatsuki Runa](https://sovia.work/en-US/creator) — @id https://sovia.work/en-US/creator#person
- Fictional central character: [Sovia Rabocheva](https://sovia.work/en-US/characters/sovia) — @id https://sovia.work/en-US/characters/sovia#character
- In-universe Runa: [character profile](https://sovia.work/en-US/characters/runa) — The real-world creator and in-universe Runa use the same stage name. Their profile IDs separate real-world biography from story facts. The +i marker classifies world of origin only; it does not establish whether this role is an avatar, self-insert, or separate fictional person.
